name: std::type_info::before
intro: Returns true if the type of this type_info precedes the type of rhs in the implementation's collation order. No guarantees are given; in particular, the collation order can change between the invocations of the same program.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
rhs

 -

 another type information object to compare to

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the type of this type_info precedes the type of rhs in the implementation's collation order.

examples.output: char goes before int in this implementation.
